reconstruction: committed float32 recurrent-state anchors and committed trace RGB snapshots, four updates per decision

source.name: Full MaleCNS checkpoint recurrent state
source.normalization: abs(state) with fixed regional display gains optic=1, central=16, descending=16; clipped [0,1], nearest uint8 / 255; model magnitude, not biological recordings
source.selectionRule: At most 1536 nonzero signals, equal quotas for measured optic/central/descending regions; half each quota prioritizes actual magnitude changes, rest strongest nonzero state; ties by body ID. No random or timed pulses.
